Evidence for the two design choices. The purity figures rule out labelling a polygon by its dominant land-cover class. The bound figures rule out the median: the within-unit distributions are not skewed (skewness near zero) but are bimodal at the bounds, so the median collapses onto an endpoint for a large share of units while the mean does not. The mean is therefore primary and the median is kept as a diagnostic.
